title: Lycurgus Cup: A Roman glass goblet made with ancient color-changing nanotechnology
caption:
A Roman goblet that changes hue isn’t magic—it’s nanotech. Researchers decoded the ancient recipe and recreated the effect with modern glass. The mystery of intentional design remains.

Source: Livescience - Lycurgus Cup: A Roman glass goblet made with ancient color-changing nanotechnology

https://www.livescience.com/archaeology/romans/lycurgus-cup-a-roman-glass-goblet-made-with-ancient-color-changing-nanotechnology
